import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long P = 1000000007L;

    static class Matrix {
        static final int N = 33;
        int n;
        long[][] a;

        Matrix(int n, int k) {
            this.n = n;
            a = new long[N][N];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                a[i][i] = k;
            }
        }

        Matrix(int n) {
            this(n, 0);
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix m) {
            if (this.n != m.n) throw new AssertionError();
            Matrix res = new Matrix(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        res.a[i][k] = (res.a[i][k] + a[i][j] * m.a[j][k]) % P;
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix pow(int x) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(n, 1);
            Matrix base = this;
            while (x > 0) {
                if ((x & 1) == 1) {
                    res = res.multiply(base);
                }
                base = base.multiply(base);
                x >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }

        long[] getRow(int index) {
            return a[index];
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        final long P = 1000000007L;

        if (n <= k) {
            System.out.println((1L << n) % P);
            return;
        }

        int logN = (int) (Math.log(n + 0.0) / Math.log(k + 0.0) + 2);

        Matrix shift = new Matrix(k + 1, 1);
        for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
            shift.a[j][j] = 0;
            shift.a[(j + 1) % k][j] = 1;
        }

        Matrix[] block = new Matrix[logN];
        block[0] = new Matrix(k + 1, 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            block[0].a[0][i] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < logN; i++) {
            block[i] = block[i - 1].multiply(shift).pow(k);
        }

        int i = 0;
        long len = 1;
        while (n / len >= k) {
            i++;
            len *= k;
        }

        Matrix m = new Matrix(k + 1, 1);
        long remainingN = n;
        long currentLen = len;
        while (remainingN > 0) {
            if (currentLen <= remainingN) {
                int x = (int) (remainingN / currentLen);
                m = m.multiply((block[i].multiply(shift)).pow(x));
                remainingN -= currentLen * x;
            }
            i--;
            currentLen /= k;
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int idx = 0; idx <= k; idx++) {
            ans = (ans + m.getRow(idx)[k]) % P;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
